newsitem.title: USA: Palm Beach Cty, Fla., proposes property tax hike.
newsitem.headline: Palm Beach Cty, Fla., proposes property tax hike.

text.p: Florida's Palm Beach County administrator has recommended that the county raise property tax rates by about 8 percent, the Sun-Sentinel reported.
The proposal by County Administrator Bob Weisman would increase the tax rate to $4.60 per $1,000 of taxable value, from $4.23 per $1,000 of taxable value.
The proposal would raise an additional $20 million a year, covering about half the county's anticipated $41 million gap in its proposed $1.9 billion budget for fiscal 1998.
Weisman told county commissioners the increase is needed to offset a drop in utility tax collections and a decline in property tax revenues that stemmed from a voter-initiated cap on assessments.
Additionally, he said, the increase is needed to help pay debt service on the county's new courthouse.
The proposal is pending before the county commission.
